name: ask-user-rich
description: One stable Thread page per conversation for the model's questions: Rounds answered in a rich form, answers that come back by themselves, links drawn in the transcript.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Serve ask_user_rich through the Thread page (tools, links, guard, mirroring)

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: Addresses the page binds, comma-separated (loopback plus a tailnet address, for example)

publicHost.title: Public host
publicHost.description: Host of the Public link (another device); a loopback name shows no Public link

port.title: Port
port.description: The one port every Thread page is served on
